title: Upper Kharadi, Kharadi Annex, New Kharadi: what the address on MahaRERA really says
audience: IT professionals and families, 28-45, working in Kharadi, Viman Nagar or Kalyani Nagar, budget ₹1.5-4 crore for a 2-4 BHK, comparing Kharadi with Upper Kharadi; English
message: Upper Kharadi, Kharadi Annex and New Kharadi are sales names; most Upper Kharadi projects carry Wagholi's PIN 412207 on MahaRERA, New Kharadi (VTP Pegasus) is on the Manjari side (PIN 412307); check the village and survey number on the 7/12 before any token.
facts: Upper Kharadi is a market name, not a village in the land records: the stretch along Upper Kharadi Main Road, north-east of EON IT Park, towards Ubale Nagar and Wagholi. Source: Avasetu guide /guides/upper-kharadi, 18 October 2026.

Most projects sold as Upper Kharadi (Lodha Giardino, Lodha Estilo, Lodha Camelot, Gera's Island of Joy, My Home Upper Kharadi, Mahindra IvyLush) carry PIN 412207, which is Wagholi's PIN, on MahaRERA. Kharadi proper is PIN 411014. Source: MahaRERA register read by Avasetu on 18 October 2026.
Mahindra calls its project Kharadi Annex (press release, 30 December 2024); it also carries PIN 412207.
VTP's Pegasus township, often sold as New Kharadi, is on the Manjari side, PIN 412307 (VTP Dolce Vita on MahaRERA).
Wagholi came into Pune Municipal Corporation limits in 2021.
Buyers should read the village and survey number on the 7/12 extract and the sale agreement before paying any token.

caption:
Upper Kharadi vs Kharadi Annex vs New Kharadi: what the address really says

Three sales names, one question: where is the flat on paper?

📍 Most Upper Kharadi projects (Lodha Giardino, Estilo, Camelot, Gera Island of Joy, Mahindra IvyLush "Kharadi Annex") carry PIN 412207 on MahaRERA. That is Wagholi's PIN. Kharadi proper is 411014.
📍 "New Kharadi" is often VTP's Pegasus township, on the Manjari side (PIN 412307).

Nothing wrong with that. Just compare prices with the right neighbours, and read the village and survey number on the 7/12 before you pay a token.
